page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmr9ae.48xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 192 dedicated AMD EPYC 9T95 vCPUs operating at a base clock speed of 2.25 GHz. The system is equipped with 1536.0 GB of system memory, establishing an exact 1:8 ratio of vCPUs to RAM, which equates to 8.0 GB of memory per core.

This server configuration does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 100 Gbps, which facilitates high-throughput data transfers for distributed environments.

Given the high density of dedicated AMD EPYC cores and substantial memory capacity, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring large in-memory footprints without the overhead of local storage maintenance. The hardware profile is designed for memory-intensive applications, large-scale databases, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-bound data processing pipelines.
